item.title: The Fire Was Meant To Frame His Ex
item.description: In 2012, Mick Philpott and two others deliberately set fire to his Derby home in a plan to frame his former lover. The blaze killed six children. Philpott was convicted of six counts of manslaughter and sentenced to life with a minimum term of 15 years.

item.title: He Killed His Family To Hide His Double Life
item.description: Chris Coleman was convicted of murdering his wife Sheri and their two sons, Garett and Gavin, in 2009. Prosecutors argued he planned the killings to escape his marriage and protect his secret affair, and a jury sentenced him to three consecutive life terms.

item.title: The Hospital Worker Who Hid A Double Life
item.description: David Fuller worked in hospitals for decades while secretly committing murders and sexual offences against deceased patients. After his arrest in 2020, investigators uncovered more than 100 victims. He pleaded guilty to two murders and numerous other offences and received a whole-life sentence.

item.title: The Ice Cream Shop Hid A Double Murder
item.description: Estibaliz Carranza murdered her ex-husband in 2008 and her boyfriend in 2010. Their remains were hidden beneath her Vienna ice cream shop until workers discovered them in 2011. Carranza confessed and was sentenced to life in prison, with the conviction upheld on appeal.

item.title: The 13 Year Old Who Killed His Little Sister
item.description: In 2007, 13-year-old Paris Bennett killed his four-year-old sister, Ella, in their Texas home. He pleaded guilty to capital murder and received 40 years in prison, the maximum juvenile sentence, with eligibility for parole after 20 years.

item.title: A Routine Traffic Stop Ended Rifkin’s Killing Spree
item.description: Joel Rifkin confessed to killing 17 women between 1989 and 1993. His crimes ended when police stopped him for a missing license plate and discovered a woman’s body in his truck. Rifkin was ultimately convicted of nine murders and sentenced to 203 years to life.

item.title: She Killed Her Foster Mother For Her Foster Father
item.description: In 2012, 17-year-old Sabrina Zunich killed her foster mother, Lisa Knoefel, after prosecutors said she and foster father Kevin Knoefel plotted the murder. Zunich later pleaded guilty to aggravated murder and was sentenced to 30 years to life.

item.title: His Horrorcore Lyrics Became Reality
item.description: Richard McCroskey, who performed as Syko Sam, traveled from California to Virginia after meeting Emma Niederbrock online. In 2009, he killed Emma, her mother, her father and her friend. He later pleaded guilty to four murders and received four life sentences.
